## README.md
# 10,000 Crop Field Boundaries across India with ML Splits

Manually delineated crop fields across India, with a fixed train/val/test partition for machine learning.

## Contents

- `india_10k_ml.parquet`, 10,013 polygon features

## Splits

| Split | Features |
| ----- | -------- |
| `train` | 6,495 |
| `val` | 1,510 |
| `test` | 2,008 |
| **total** | **10,013** |

The `split` column carries this partition. Use it as given, so that results stay comparable across models trained on this dataset.

## Format

- GeoParquet 1.1.0, geometry encoded as WKB, all features are Polygons
- Coordinate reference system: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84)
- Conforms to the fiboa 0.3.0 specification

## Columns

| Column | Notes |
| ------ | ----- |
| `geometry` | Field boundary polygon |
| `collection` | Collection identifier carried from the source |
| `metrics:area` | Field area in square metres |
| `split` | Machine learning partition, see above |
| `id` | Unique feature identifier |
| `bbox` | Bounding box struct, enables spatial row group pruning |

## Notes

The `collection` value stored inside the file is `in_10k_ml`, which differs from the product name.
